record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: Can the definitions and basic properties of deformations of manifolds with boundary be reformulated naturally in the language of groupoids and torsors?

evidence.quote: Question 6. Express the definitions and properties of deformations of manifolds with boundaries in the language of groupoids and torsors.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth manifold with boundary $\partial M$, and consider the deformation theory of such manifolds with boundary, i.e., the study of families of smooth structures on $M$ (and on a neighborhood of $\partial M$) modulo equivalence, together with the standard notions of infinitesimal deformations, obstructions, and equivalences of deformations.

Recall that a groupoid is a small category in which every morphism is invertible, and that a torsor over a group (or groupoid) $G$ is a set (or space) $X$ equipped with a free and transitive action of $G$.

Provide a natural reformulation of the basic definitions and fundamental properties of deformations of manifolds with boundary purely in the language of groupoids and torsors. Specifically:

1. Define a groupoid (or stack of groupoids) whose objects are deformations of a given manifold with boundary and whose morphisms are equivalences of such deformations.
2. Identify the relevant torsor structures controlling infinitesimal deformations and their automorphisms (for instance, expressing first-order deformations and their gauge equivalences as torsors over appropriate sheaves of groups arising from the boundary geometry).
3. Verify that the standard properties of deformations of manifolds with boundary (existence, uniqueness up to equivalence, obstruction calculus, behavior under restriction to the boundary) are recovered naturally in this groupoid/torsor framework.
artifact.category_tag: Deformation theory of manifolds with boundary
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface any published reformulation of the deformation theory of manifolds with boundary in the language of groupoids and torsors. While related machinery exists (Illusie's cotangent complex and deformations of torsors, deformation theory via Lie groupoids and stacks), no source explicitly carries out this program for manifolds with boundary, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Cotangent complex and deformations of torsors and group schemes
status_evidence.snippet: Illusie's framework for deformations of torsors and group schemes via the cotangent complex.
status_evidence.claim: Related general machinery exists for deformations of torsors, but not specifically for manifolds with boundary.

status_evidence.title: Groupoids, Deformations and Noncommutative Geometry - Penn State
status_evidence.snippet: Project on groupoids and deformations in noncommutative geometry.
status_evidence.claim: Groupoid-based deformation theory is studied in adjacent contexts, not directly for manifolds with boundary.

status_evidence.title: Joint deformations of manifolds, coherent sheaves and sections
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on deformations of manifolds and associated structures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent deformation-theory work does not appear to provide the requested groupoid/torsor reformulation for manifolds with boundary.
